introSection.heading: Evaluating Princess Plus Value
introSection.p1: Princess Plus can make a Princess Cruises vacation more convenient by bundling drinks, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, casual dining, and delivery benefits into one daily price. But is it worth paying extra for these services, or would you spend less by choosing the standard cruise fare and purchasing only what you need?
introSection.p2: The answer depends on your habits. Guests who enjoy cocktails, specialty coffee, regular internet access, and casual dining may get meaningful value from Princess Plus. Travelers who rarely buy drinks, do not need Wi-Fi, or prefer the included dining options may be better off without it.
introSection.p3: This guide breaks down the current Princess Plus price, its benefits, a realistic seven-night cost example, and the situations in which the package makes financial sense.

inclusions.title: What Does Princess Plus Include?
inclusions.subtitle: Six core onboard amenities bundled into one predictable daily package

features.title: 1. Plus Beverage Package
features.description: Covers eligible alcoholic drinks up to $15 each (maximum 15 alcoholic drinks per 24-hour period), plus unlimited specialty coffees, teas, fountain sodas, zero-proof mocktails, and up to 12 bottled waters (500 ml) daily.

features.title: 2. MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi (1 Device)
features.description: High-speed satellite connectivity for one device per guest, supporting messaging, email, web browsing, social media, video streaming, and travel updates from anywhere onboard.

features.title: 3. Crew Appreciation (Gratuities)
features.description: Prepaid crew appreciation covered under eligible package terms ($18/day for Interior/Oceanview/Balcony, $19/day for Mini-Suites, $20/day for Suites), representing $126–$140 in direct savings per guest on a 7-night sailing.

features.title: 4. Four Casual Dining Meals
features.description: Includes 4 qualifying prix fixe casual dining meals per guest per voyage at venues such as Alfredo's Pizzeria, Kai Sushi, or Ocean Terrace (normally carrying a $14.99 cover charge each).

features.title: 5. OceanNow Delivery Access
features.description: The one-time $14.99 OceanNow onboard delivery access fee is completely waived, allowing you to order drinks and food directly to your poolside lounger or ship location via the Princess app.

features.title: 6. Room-Service Delivery
features.description: Complimentary room-service delivery throughout the voyage under current package terms, waiving the standard $5 per stateroom phone order delivery fee.

decisionGuide.title: Who Should Buy Princess Plus vs. Who May Not Need It
decisionGuide.consTitle: Who May Not Need Princess Plus
shouldBuy: You enjoy several cocktails, glasses of wine, beer, or morning specialty coffees each day
You want reliable satellite Wi-Fi for one device to stay in touch with family or work
You appreciate having daily crew gratuities ($18–$20/day) pre-paid and settled upfront
You plan to take advantage of four sit-down casual dining meals at Alfredo's or Kai Sushi
You value peace of mind and budget predictability with zero surprise charges at disembarkation
mayNotNeed: You drink little to no alcohol and are satisfied with complimentary iced tea, drip coffee, and water
You prefer to completely unplug from the internet and do not need onboard Wi-Fi
You are perfectly happy eating exclusively in the main dining rooms and buffet without casual dining venues
You prefer to keep your upfront holiday fare as low as possible and pay à la carte only for what you consume
Your cruise is port-intensive and you plan to spend nearly all your waking hours ashore

bookingRules.title: Important Princess Plus Booking Rules to Know
bookingRules.subtitle: Key deadlines, stateroom policies, and conditions before adding the package

steps.title: Purchase 96 Hours in Advance
steps.description: To lock in the published pre-cruise rate ($70/day on standard ships, $75 on Sun/Star Princess), purchase your package at least four days before departure. Purchasing onboard incurs an extra $5 per person, per day surcharge.

steps.title: Stateroom Guest Policies
steps.description: Princess Plus generally applies to guests one and two on the reservation. Third and fourth guests in the same stateroom are not automatically required to purchase the package.

steps.title: Casual Dining Usage
steps.description: The four casual dining meals are allocated per guest for the entire voyage. Unused meals are non-refundable and cannot be carried over to subsequent sailings.

steps.title: Upgrade to Premier Flexibility
steps.description: Guests who book Princess Plus can easily upgrade to Princess Premier before departure or onboard by paying the $35 per person, per day price difference.

faqs.question: Is Princess Plus worth the money?
faqs.answer: Princess Plus can be worth the money if you regularly use eligible drinks, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, and casual dining benefits. If you would rarely use these services, the standard fare may cost less overall.

faqs.question: How much does Princess Plus cost per day?
faqs.answer: The published pre-cruise USD price is $70 per person, per day on most Princess ships and $75 on Sun Princess and Star Princess. The lower rate requires purchase at least 96 hours before departure.

faqs.question: How much is Princess Plus for a seven-day cruise?
faqs.answer: For a seven-night cruise, Princess Plus costs $490 per person on most ships or $525 per person on Sun Princess and Star Princess at the published pre-cruise rates ($980 or $1,050 for two guests).

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include unlimited drinks?
faqs.answer: No. The Plus Beverage Package covers eligible drinks priced up to $15 each and has a limit of 15 alcoholic beverages during a 24-hour period. Specialty coffees, teas, fountain sodas, and zero-proof cocktails do not count toward that alcoholic limit, and bottled water has a separate daily limit of 12 bottles.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Princess Plus includes MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi for one device per guest, subject to onboard network availability and satellite coverage.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include gratuities?
faqs.answer: Eligible Princess Plus purchases include crew appreciation paid on behalf of guests under the package terms. The applicable daily amount depends on the stateroom category ($18 for Balcony, $19 for Mini-Suites, $20 for Suites).

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include specialty dining?
faqs.answer: No. Princess Plus includes four qualifying casual dining meals per guest per voyage (Alfredo's Pizzeria, Kai Sushi, Ocean Terrace). Specialty restaurant cover charges (Crown Grill, Sabatini's) are not included.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include shore excursions?
faqs.answer: No. Shore excursions are purchased separately. Princess Premier provides shore excursion credit based on voyage length ($100–$300), but Princess Plus does not.

faqs.question: Is Princess Plus cheaper when booked in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current published USD pre-cruise price is $5 per person, per day lower than the onboard price. To qualify, purchase at least 96 hours before the scheduled departure.

faqs.question: Can one person in a stateroom buy Princess Plus?
faqs.answer: Package eligibility and participation requirements depend on the booking. Princess states that package purchases generally apply to guests one and two on the reservation, while third and fourth guests are not automatically required to purchase the same package.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Princess Plus to Princess Premier?
faqs.answer: Princess allows eligible guests to upgrade, subject to booking conditions and availability, by paying the $35 per person, per day difference.

faqs.question: Is Princess Plus worth it for someone who does not drink alcohol?
faqs.answer: It may be, but it depends on how much you value Wi-Fi, crew appreciation ($18/day), specialty coffee, bottled water, casual dining, and delivery benefits. If you do not drink alcohol and would not use the other services much, the standard fare may be more economical.
